anchors.text: Death-temple country. Archpriest Gorthan has died thrice and returned by soulbinding — a fact his priests cite when selling name-recovery and boneglass rites.

Archpriest Gorthan (Vaskurhollow) — Thrice-dead soulbound pontiff; sells name-recovery rites tied to Tier 8 Duskshard gossip; publicly denounces Umbra cults, privately trades with Vaskurhollow boneglass cartels.
Gorthan's Letter — Archpriest offers soulbinding rescue if the party retrieves a true name from Floor 76 — the name is a PC's.

positiveFacts: Gorthan is a named lore character, reported as having died and returned by soulbinding.
The Chronicle contains an adventure seed involving a true name that belongs to a PC and a proposed soulbinding rescue.
limitations: The Gorthan letter is explicitly categorized as an adventure seed, not a record of an occurred campaign event.
The source does not identify the PC, bind a current body or current/max HP profile, record a lawful Final Word cast or committed death, or establish the named identity's soul availability.
The source does not resolve the soulbinding procedure, current holder/custody, capture bars, Hunt/HuntedDeath state, or Gorthan's origin/summon/no-resource-farm facts.
Soulbinding is not mapped to the distinct Soul Bind spell without an exact source procedure.
sourceClassification.disposition: Retain as a source lead for Director review; it does not satisfy DR217-B01 or instantiate any identity, campaign event, token, payment, or capture permission.

required: one exact independent victim identity with source-established current body and HP, available soul, actual final-death history, and custody/capture-bar/Hunt/origin facts

an actual qualifying Final Word capture followed by eligible one-spell base-RP payment, unused-remainder loss, counter/nonrefund, distinct concurrent tokens, and original next-completed-long-rest expiry
notRequired: reopening approved Pact or Doom procedures
